plain_text:
Georgia Ellis appears in 466 recordings across 18 programs in the Golden Radio Hour archive from 1949 to 1961. The credits here include performer.

In this archive, you will hear Georgia Ellis most often in Gunsmoke, Escape, Dr. Kildare, This Is Your FBI, The Adventures of Philip Marlowe, Yours Truly, Johnny Dollar, Broadway Is My Beat, and The Whistler.

Characters credited here include Kitty Russell.
